description: This file defines the ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware class, which is a middleware component for AWS SDK client-side monitoring. It provides methods for wrapping handlers, extracting request and response data, and managing monitoring events related to API calls.

classes.name: ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for monitoring API calls in AWS SDK client operations, capturing attempt data, handling retries, and integrating with monitoring events.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware handler wrapping the given credential provider, options, region, and service.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Extracts and returns request data; currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Processes the response or exception to retrieve attempt counts, max retries, and final attempt data.

methods.name: getResultAttemptCount
methods.description: Counts HTTP transfer stats attempts from a ResultInterface object.

methods.name: getExceptionAttemptCount
methods.description: Counts the number of API call attempts from an exception that implements MonitoringEventsInterface.

methods.name: getFinalAttemptData
methods.description: Aggregates data from the final monitoring event if available.

methods.name: getFinalAttempt
methods.description: Finds and returns the last 'ApiCallAttempt' event from an array of monitoring events.

methods.name: getMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates maximum retries have been exceeded.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Adds the event type 'ApiCall' and populates request data.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Populates result event data and calculates latency.
